title: Under Arrest
paragraphs: A police procedural drama following law-enforcement investigations, represented in surviving episodes especially by Joe DeSantis as Captain Jim Scott.

Mutual police procedural. Early summers featured Capt. John Drake; by about 1948 the central role became Capt. Jim Scott. The frozen GRH object is the 1950-08-06 Jim Scott broadcast known as The Willing Victim Report.

GRH documents the program through Mutual summer-replacement era (July 28, 1946 to September 5, 1948) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] and Continuing Mutual run (November 7, 1948 to October 4, 1954) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Al Fanelli (composer on 1 recording and conductor on 1 recording), Court Benson (performer on 1 recording), Eric Dressler (performer on 1 recording), Joe DeSantis (performer on 1 recording), Ken Marvin (announcer on 1 recording), Paul Milton (writer on 1 recording), and Rita Lynn (performer on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include police procedural investigation, confidence scheme and fraud, airport and aviation setting, racketeering and organized crime, and murder investigation.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Under Arrest continuing Mutual run, Under Arrest lead-character transition, The Willing Victim Report broadcast, and Under Arrest summer-replacement era.
